quotes.text: Claims What is claimed is: 1. A method of obtaining purified curcumin comprising the steps of : a) admixing (1) impure curcumin comprising curcumin and curcuminoids and having a curcumin purity up to about 75% by weight, (2) a reagent which provides a phenol protecting group, and (3) an optional catalyst under conditions sufficient to control reactivity of the hydroxyl groups of the curcuminoids and the reagent which provides a phenol protecting group to form a mixture of curcumin and at least one curcuminoid having at least one phenol protecting group; b) crystallizing the mixture of step (a) in at least one organic solvent to form curcumin crystals, wherein the curcumin crystals have a curcumin purity of at least about 99% by weight.
